subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers land the open fork cleanup PR, replace it with a same-repo cleanup, or close that candidate and keep this issue as the canonical bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and the fix shape is narrow, but an open linked fork PR already references this issue with closing syntax and has stale failing checks, so automation should not create a competing fix lane without maintainer intent.

options.title: Review or replace linked cleanup
options.body: Use the open fork PR as the current candidate, then either refresh and land it with proof or open an equivalent same-repo replacement.

options.title: Close candidate, keep issue
options.body: Close the fork PR if it is not usable and leave this issue open as the canonical source-reproducible bug.

options.title: Defer to broader lifecycle work
options.body: Sequence this behind the related Google Chat placeholder lifecycle work if maintainers want one larger delivery refactor.

recommendation.title: Review or replace linked cleanup
recommendation.body: Use the open fork PR as the current candidate, then either refresh and land it with proof or open an equivalent same-repo replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent Google Chat reply-delivery hardening and monitor cleanup history make this the best available routing owner.
